description: Na₄YHfSi₂PO₁₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cc space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.51-3.03 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.99 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.47-2.83 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.53-2.79 Å. Y is bonded to six O atoms to form YO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Y-O bond distances ranging from 2.13-2.33 Å. Hf is bonded to six O atoms to form HfO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Hf-O bond distances ranging from 2.04-2.18 Å. There are two inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent YO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent HfO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 25-39°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.62-1.68 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent YO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent HfO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 26-38°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.61-1.67 Å. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent YO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent HfO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 25-36°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.53-1.57 Å. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Y, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Y, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Y, and one Si atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to two Na, one Hf, and one Si atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Hf, and one Si atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na, one Hf, and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Y, and one Si atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₃YSi trigonal bipyramids. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Y, and one Si atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Y, and one P atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Hf, and one P atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Hf, and one Si atom to form distorted ONa₃HfSi trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent ONa₃YSi trigonal bipyramids and  a faceface with one ONa₃HfSi trigonal bipyramid. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Hf, and one Si atom to form distorted ONa₃HfSi trigonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one ONa₃YSi trigonal bipyramid,  an edgeedge with one ONa₃YSi trigonal bipyramid, and  a faceface with one ONa₃HfSi trigonal bipyramid.
